turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation. Your visit suggests that the matter cannot be resolved without our assistance.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, I sense that this is a matter of great importance, and I am eager to hear the details of your case, Your Majesty.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that I have placed myself in a most precarious position by seeking your assistance. My reputation, nay, the very future of my kingdom hangs in the balance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to be discreet. I fear that if my true identity becomes known, I shall be forced to abdicate my throne, and my kingdom shall fall into chaos.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I find it intriguing that you are so concerned about discretion, yet you have already revealed your royal identity to us. I am not one to pry into matters of state, but I do require clarity on the nature of the problem.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I find your situation to be a curious one. You have come to me, a private detective, for assistance with a matter of state, yet you seem to be more concerned with preserving your royal reputation than with solving the actual problem at hand.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of my situation. My very existence is at stake, and I fear that if I do not take drastic measures, my kingdom shall fall into the hands of those who would misuse its power.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I have been driven to desperation by the events that have transpired, and I fear that I am but one misstep away from catastrophe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the mention of catastrophe. Pray tell, what events have led you to believe that your kingdom is on the brink of disaster?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Pray tell, Your Majesty, which individuals or groups do you believe pose this threat to your kingdom's stability?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that I have revealed too much already. The individuals who pose this threat are... (pausing, glancing around the room) ...those who would use my kingdom's power for their own purposes, and I must confess that I am not certain who they are, or how they intend to act.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am perplexed by your reluctance to reveal the specifics of the threat you face. Might I humbly suggest that, if you entrust us with the details, we may be better equipped to offer guidance and assistance in resolving this crisis?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal the specifics of this threat. The withholding of information will only hinder our ability to assist you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am beset by an unending torrent of anxiety, gentlemen. The burden of my position weighs heavily upon me, and the thought of revealing my true identity to you is a prospect that fills me with trepidation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I will not be swayed by your emotional appeals, Your Majesty. The specifics of this threat are what I require, and I will not rest until I have them.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand, Your Majesty, that this is a difficult position for you to be in, but I must agree with Mr. Holmes that the sooner we have the facts, the sooner we can begin to work towards a resolution. Might I suggest that we start by examining the circumstances of the photograph you mentioned earlier, as it seems to be a crucial piece of evidence in this matter?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I have been pondering the significance of the photograph and its potential connection to your predicament. Might I request that you reveal the circumstances surrounding the creation of this photograph, as it may hold the key to unraveling this enigma?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must confess that I am intrigued by the complexities of your situation, and I am more determined than ever to uncover the truth behind this photograph. I believe that a thorough examination of the circumstances surrounding its creation may reveal a crucial thread in the tapestry of this enigma.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you, Your Majesty, provide me with a detailed account of the circumstances surrounding the creation of this photograph, as Dr. Watson's inquiries have only served to deepen my interest in this matter.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I suggest we proceed with caution, Your Majesty, as the circumstances surrounding this photograph may be more complex than initially thought.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
